mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE exceeding 5.0%) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that lowers corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE above 7.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy that supports equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent strength in retail sales (RSAFS above its 12-month average) reflects robust consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary tightening coinciding with supply shock, severely dampening corporate earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During weak housing market regimes (HOUST below 500.0 thousand units), housing sector weakness signals broader economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 500.0.
